set.body:
Complete the remaining volregger estimator modes that belong in shared code, or encode explicit typed deferrals where the semantics are not yet justified.

Contracts: IC stencil, nuisance residual, and whitening behavior are selected through typed policies, not strings or option bags; defaults preserve current byte/behavior unless a policy is explicitly enabled; whitening has deterministic numerical tests and clear failure modes.

Deliverables: ADTs/control groups for IC stencil and whitening, estimator integration where supported, documented unsupported combinations where not, and fixture-backed tests from test-ic-efficacy.R plus synthetic ablation suites.

Acceptance: global intensity offsets still pass the nuisance residual regression; IC/whitening profiles no longer pretend to be executable until their contracts are implemented; motionJVM/test and motionJS/test pass for supported shared paths.
set.title: Implement motion IC stencil and whitening policies
